verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud marketing says you can understand production systems using natural language and lists AI features including Grafana Assistant and Investigations. Knowledge Graph promises insights with "no complex queries required", and an official MCP server lets external AI agents reach Grafana data. None of the evidence shows a natural-language question producing an actual query (PromQL/LogQL) or a chart. missing for 10: documentation that NL prompts generate real queries or panels/charts, details of Grafana Assistant's query-generation behavior, availability in OSS vs Cloud-only, independent or hands-on corroboration.
